_comment: Chat models offered in the UI. Local models are Ollama tags; any other model installed in Ollama is listed too. The cloud entry uses GAIA_MODEL from .env (the cloud model and its requests are fixed). New chats start on `default` (the cloud model).
_comment_vision: Vision models read video frames for on-screen names (Settings → Speakers); kept apart from chat models because a chat model may be text-only. Chosen with scripts/benchmark_vision_models.py.
_comment_speakers: speaker_default reads the transcript to identify speakers (local only); vision_default reads video frames. Chosen with scripts/benchmark_screen_names.py and benchmark_vision_models.py. speeds: measured on the M4 MacBook Air until this Mac has measured its own.

models.label: Gemma 4 E4B
models.description: Google Gemma 4, 4B effective parameters, 128k context. Fast, strong summaries.

models.label: Qwen3 8B
models.description: Alibaba Qwen3, 8B parameters. Good reasoning and tool JSON.

models.label: Qwen3 4B
models.description: Small and fast, but always reasons first (slow to start replying).

models.label: GLM-5.3 Flash
models.description: Globant GAIA cloud. Sends content off this Mac.

vision_models.label: Qwen3-VL 4B
vision_models.description: Best at spotting the highlighted tile in our tests (thin, white and Zoom/Meet borders); about 9 s per frame.

vision_models.label: Gemma 4 E4B
vision_models.description: Fastest (about 4 s per frame) but misses thin and white highlight borders.
